thread.title: Summarize Voynich research attempts
thread.preview: Can you give me another complete summary of everything we've attempted with the Voynich manuscript - every test, what they've shown, what's worked, what hasn't, and what approaches might be the most likely to work based on all of the above?

items.text:
**The frozen repair passed all fresh-control gates, with unchanged thresholds.** I then reran the manuscript test—but one manuscript panel still failed nuisance adequacy.

The repair uses held-out learning folios to select one blended predictor, replacing the small validation split and four successive weights.

Across **2,700 fresh datasets**:

- All **18 nuisance-control cells passed**.
- Weak-signal detections: **94/100, 95/100, 97/100**.
- Strong-signal detections: **95/100, 98/100, 99/100**.

The manuscript results, with H/F kept separate:

| Panel | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Bathing H/F | Met adequacy requirements; no qualifying interaction finding. |
| Starred F | Met adequacy requirements; no finding, with only one eligible distant-word feature. |
| Starred H | Failed nuisance adequacy and learned no eligible distant-word features. **Uninformative**, rather than evidence against a dependency. |

All earlier and new failures remain preserved. No thresholds were relaxed or results rescued through refitting. Independent score, model-selection, source-coverage, and hash checks passed.

**The control failure is repaired under the tested conditions; the manuscript’s sparsity and starred-H predictor failure remain unresolved.**

[Full report and failures](C:/Users/lewis/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/Voynich/sh-qok-weak-score-v2/report.html) · [Frozen repair](C:/Users/lewis/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/Voynich/sh-qok-weak-score-v2/PROTOCOL.md)
